target.title: fix(ai): keep OpenAI tool call id truncation UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where multi-model conversations using the `openai` provider could produce invalid Unicode tool call IDs. When a tool call ID longer than 40 characters contains a surrogate pair (emoji, CJK character) straddling position 39-40, the truncation at `normalizeToolCallId` splits the pair and leaves an unpaired high surrogate in the normalized ID sent to the API.

## Why This Change Was Made

`String.prototype.slice(0, 40)` operates on UTF-16 code units, not Unicode characters. A surrogate pair like 🐱 (`\uD83D\uDC31`) consumes 2 code units. When the cut falls between the high and low surrogates, the result is invalid Unicode that downstream consumers (OpenAI API, JSON encoders, database storage) may reject.

The fix switches from `id.slice(0, 40)` to `truncateUtf16Safe(id, 40)` from `@openclaw/normalization-core/utf16-slice`, an existing repo helper already used across the codebase for safe UTF-16 boundary truncation.

Non-goals: the `id.includes("|")` branch (call_id extraction) and non-OpenAI provider paths are unchanged — they already use `replace` + `slice` which have different semantics.

Collision check: no open PR touches `openai-completions.ts:1052` or the `normalizeToolCallId` path. Related Unicode-repair PRs (#104054, #107664, #109561, #109498, #109839) operate on different surfaces.

## User Impact

Multi-model `openai` provider conversations with tool calls now produce valid Unicode in all tool call IDs, regardless of surrogate pair placement near the 40-character boundary.

## Evidence

Exact head: `f7ef17da7dc` (2 commits on top of `origin/main` `ec3eb573bf4`)

### Format / diff check

```
$ oxfmt --check packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

$ git diff --check
# exit 0
```

### Test output (47/47 passed)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  47 passed (47)
```

New test validates:
- 41-code-unit ID with 🐱 surrogate pair at positions 39-40
- Truncated result ≤ 40 code units, no trailing unpaired high surrogate
- ASCII prefix preserved
- Zero non-null assertions (oxlint `no-non-null-assertion` clean)

### Mutation check

Revert `truncateUtf16Safe` to `id.slice(0, 40)`:

```
$ git checkout HEAD~2 -- packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.test.ts
 FAIL   truncates an oversized tool call id without cutting a surrogate pair
AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
 ❯ /[\uD800-\uDBFF]$/.test(normalizedId) → true (trailing high surrogate)
 Tests  1 failed | 46 passed (47)
```

Restore fix → 47 passed.

### CI failures on first push

- `check-lint`: 5 `no-non-null-assertion` errors in new test — fixed in `f7ef17da7dc`
- `max-lines-ratchet`: GitHub 429 rate limit on `git fetch` — transient, not code-related
- `actionlint`: workflow file lint — unrelated to this change
- `build-artifacts`: cascading failure from prerequisite jobs

### Not tested

- Live OpenAI API roundtrip with surrogate-containing tool call IDs (requires API key)
- Other provider branches (`id.includes("|")`, non-`openai` providers) — unchanged
